snapshot.text: Public system across many islands, recovering from cyclones and the 2024 earthquake. A Ministry of Health Corporate Plan 2026–2030 guides work, with disaster-resilient facilities and plans to treat cancer in the country.

priorities.title: Disaster-resilient care
priorities.text: Stronger, disaster-resilient health services for over 30,000 people.

priorities.title: Cancer care at home
priorities.text: The government moves to bring cancer treatment into the country.
